name: K8 string: a Python string constant is not read
edits: and _names_retired(node.value) and (rel, node.value) not in ALLOWED:
expect: F1f a module constant is refused

name: K8 prose is scanned: docstrings and whole-statement strings are no longer skipped
edits: isinstance(node.value, str) and id(node) not in prose \

name: K8 page-table: a statement naming a page table is not read
expect: F1h a page table changed by subscript is refused

name: K8 page-table: a membership test is counted as a use
expect: near miss: a membership test against a page table passes

name: K8 link: key_link's kind keyword is not read
edits: kinds = node.args[:1] + [kw.value for kw in node.keywords if kw.arg == "kind"]

name: K8 text: a non-Python source or config file is not read
expect: F1j a package.json script is refused

name: K8 text: an extensionless #! file is not read
K8 text: a whole-line comment is skipped again (the skip backlog #740 deleted)
expect: 15.11 a whole-line comment in a hook, a TS file and a workflow is refused (backlog #740)

name: K8 exempt: the history prefixes are not honoured
edits: return rel == SELF or any(rel.startswith(p) for p in EXEMPT_PREFIXES)

name: K8 allowed: an ALLOWED literal is allowed in every file, not only its own
edits: node.value not in {v for _, v in ALLOWED}:
expect: exempt: an ALLOWED literal is refused in any other file

name: K8 route: a route after localhost or a port is not the route
expect: a localhost url of the route is refused

name: K8 token: a retired name inside a longer file name is refused
expect: near miss: a longer file name that contains a retired one passes

name: K8 CANNOT RUN: a missing settings.json is a pass
expect: 15.14 settings.json that is missing is CANNOT RUN

name: K8 CANNOT RUN: a tree with no workflow is a pass
expect: 15.14 a tree with no workflow is CANNOT RUN, never a pass

name: K8 CANNOT RUN: a manifest that is not JSON is a pass
edits: raise CannotRun(f"{f} is not JSON ({e})") from e
expect: 15.14 a manifest that is not JSON is CANNOT RUN
